message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Details | |-------|------------|---------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• Rural interstate: 70 mph (except 55 mph on I‑10 between Houston and Dallas).
• Urban interstate: 65 mph.
• Residential streets: 25–35 mph (often 25 mph). | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Back‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless hands‑free).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021, 545.022 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has priority.
• Stop signs: stop before proceeding; yield to pedestrians.
• Yield to emergency vehicles with lights/alarms. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | | **School‑Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children.
• No passing on either side of a stopped bus with flashing red lights. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Do not cut off other drivers; maintain safe following distance. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking in front of fire hydrants, driveways, or on sidewalks. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display valid license plates.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection (except some exempt categories). | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Towing & Tow‑away Rules** | • Towing is allowed only if the vehicle is unsafe or obstructing traffic.
• Towing must be done safely and without endangering others. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Pedestrian Safety** | • Pedestrians have the right of way at crosswalks.
• Drivers must yield to pedestrians in crosswalks, even if no sign is present. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: must wear helmets (unless exempt).
• Commercial vehicles: must follow specific lane and speed regulations. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.001 | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Accessible via the Texas Legislature’s website or legal databases. 3. **Local County Courts** – For recent changes or local ordinances that supplement state law. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. - **Avoid distractions** – especially cell‑phone use; use hands‑free if you must talk. - **Observe posted speed limits** – they’re designed for safety and can vary widely. - **Yield to pedestrians and school buses** – Texas law protects them. - **Check your vehicle’s registration and inspection status** – avoid fines or impoundment. Feel free to ask if you need deeper details on any specific area, such as DUI penalties, school‑bus rules, or how to register a vehicle in Texas!
